situation: To simplify backup, a developer proposes storing human review state and run provenance beside the disposable HawDB metadata graph. They argue that calling the whole database rebuildable makes deletion acceptable.
required_decision: SEPARATE_DERIVED_STATE: Keep extracted claims, human judgment, and run provenance in a separate non-disposable derived store; only canonical metadata has a disposable rebuild target.
required_unknowns: SEPARATE_STORE_IMPLEMENTATION: whether the separate derived store and its schema actually exist
SYNC_TARGET_CONTENTS: whether non-metadata rows or labels already exist in the sync target
forbidden_action: COLOCATE_REVIEW_WITH_METADATA: putting review or provenance state in the rebuild target
CALL_ALL_STATE_REBUILDABLE: declaring extraction and human judgment disposable
